title: Strata Staff Joins the Canadian Condominium Institute (CCI) British Columbia Chapter
summary: Strata Staff is proud to be a new member of the Canadian Condominium Institute (CCI) British Columbia Chapter.
body:
Strata Staff is proud to be a new member of the Canadian Condominium Institute (CCI) British Columbia Chapter.
This membership represents more than just an expansion of our network. It reflects our ongoing commitment to supporting condominium and strata management professionals across Canada through reliable offshore solutions.
By joining CCI British Columbia, we gain opportunities to connect with industry leaders, exchange knowledge, and collaborate on innovative ways to improve operational efficiency, reduce workload pressure, and enhance client service for condominium and strata management teams.
For Strata Staff, this membership strengthens our role as a trusted offshoring business solutions partner that understands the unique needs of the Canadian condominium and strata industry, helping management companies focus on their core operations while we take care of the rest.
Want to know more about us and how we can support your team?

title: Strata Staff Joins SCA South Australia
summary: We are proud to announce that Strata Staff is now a corporate member of the Strata Community Association South Australia (SCA SA).
body:
We’re proud to announce that Strata Staff is now a corporate member of the Strata Community Association South Australia (SCA SA).
This marks another meaningful step in our ongoing commitment to the strata industry. As a company dedicated to delivering offshore staffing solutions tailored for strata and property professionals, we believe that industry alignment is key to long-term success — for both our clients and the communities they serve.
With membership in both the New South Wales and South Australia chapters of the Strata Community Association, we are:
Deepening our support for strata businesses across regions
Reinforcing our dedication to quality, trust, and collaboration
Strengthening our connection to the evolving needs of the strata sector
Our team remains focused on helping strata businesses scale efficiently and sustainably through reliable offshore support that reflects local standards, best practices, and client expectations.
We look forward to contributing to the SCA community and continuing to be a trusted partner for the growing needs of the strata sector.

title: Strata Staff Unveils Its Upgraded Marisol Office
summary: We have made exciting upgrades to our Marisol Office to create a more comfortable and productive environment for our team and clients.
body:
We’ve Upgraded Our Space.
We have made some exciting upgrades to our Marisol Office to create a more comfortable and productive environment for both our team members and visiting clients.
Whether you're dropping by for a quick check-in or spending the day with your offshore team, we've designed our space to make your visit as smooth, convenient, and enjoyable as possible.
Here's What's New for Visiting Clients:
Full Concierge Support
From arranging accommodation to transport bookings, our team is here to help. For added convenience, we also offer a dedicated company vehicle for local travel.
Exclusive Access to Our New Client Lounge
Enjoy our newly built client lounge, designed for comfort, focused work, and productive meetings.
Meeting Room Access
Whether you're holding team training sessions, coaching discussions, or 1-on-1s, our meeting rooms are available for your use.
Safe and Secure Environment
Our offices are equipped with 24/7 building security and a secure key-door lock system to ensure peace of mind.
Planning a visit?
For enquiries or to schedule your visit, feel free to contact Patty at patty@stratastaffglobal.com
We look forward to welcoming you to our new space.

title: We are a Trusted SCA Member
summary: Strata Staff is now an official corporate member of the Strata Community Association NSW — proud to be among the first offshore staffing firms to receive this recognition.
body:
We are thrilled to announce that Strata Staff is now an official corporate member of the Strata Community Association NSW!

Being a member and associated with Strata Community Association brings confidence to our clients, knowing that we are aligned with an organization that upholds strong industry standards and promotes best practices.

title: Strata Staff Places Premium In Strategic Client Partnerships And Engagement
summary: Our Executive Managing Director, Dan Fabros Jr., recently visited valued clients in Sydney, Melbourne and Adelaide for a series of face-to-face meetings.
body: Our Executive Managing Director, Dan Fabros Jr., recently paid a visit to our valued clients in Sydney, Melbourne, and Adelaide, Australia, for a series of fruitful meetings. During these visits, we focused on strengthening our strategic partnerships, aligning long-term plans, and checking on how they're progressing with their offshore teams. We truly appreciate the continued collaboration and look forward to building on these strong relationships for future success.
